faqs.q: Sec. 78-151. - Correction of errors in proceedings; waiver of procedures.
faqs.a:
(a)
It shall be the duty of the council, and it shall have the power by any subsequent
               proceedings, to correct any mistakes, errors or irregularities in any of the proceedings
               mentioned herein.
(b)
Any of the provisions of this article may be waived in writing by the owners of all
               property in the district which is to be assessed, and by the mayor if the city is
               to bear any of the costs of the improvements. Such a waiver must state the requirements
               of this article which are being waived. No person shall be permitted to withdraw a
               written waiver once it has been submitted to the council for consideration. The authorization
               for such a waiver shall be contained within the ordinance establishing the district.
(Code 1981, § 27-151; Ord. No. 551, § 92, 5-14-1964; Ord. No. 2294, § 7, 7-7-1986)
